comments.body:
**History expiry**

Followup from last ACDE: 

- It seems there is consensus on using the CL block retention window for history expiry. I'd be keen to either update 4444 or have some informational EIP so that this is documented

- [Nethermind PR](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/12808) to change it is here. Is there an update from other clients?

- Could clients and other entities also update [history endpoints](https://eth-clients.github.io/history-endpoints/) so we have a list of folks who are providing history? [Nethermind and PandaOps added here](https://github.com/eth-clients/history-endpoints/pull/17)

**PQ**

The current beacon deposit contract (and a few others) are not suitable for PQ. 

There are two high level strategies to supporting the new PQ functionality: deploy a new deposit contract, modify the old deposit contract via an irregular state transition (adding a new function for PQ).

I would like to get the opinions on how folks think we should move forward.

Also curious to know why we are not using a precompile/tx/opcode for deposits, was this a part of the design space?

I would like to do a quick demo of the proposed API for the EIP-8304 trustless log index (which answers log search queries with efficient proofs and also offers advanced features compared to the json rpc log query). This should be useful for evaluating the current maturity level of the project and the merits of the eip before the hegota eip ranking deadline.

To simplify implementation, I am withdrawing EIP-7686, EIP-7971, and EIP-7923 (PFId) from the PFI list. I am currently left with the following four PFI EIPs:
EIP-7609: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11893
EIP-7973: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11892
EIP-8058: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11894
EIP-8360: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12074
I am not withdrawing EIP-7923 and will champion this EIP.

hi @Helkomine i'll add them to the agenda - each of these will still need someone to speak for them. if no one can speak for them on this Thursday's call, they'll be dropped from PFI and will need to be re-proposed for i-star
